title_en: Villa for sale at Hipoteka in Tirana
description_en: Albanopolis Street, we have for sale a 3-storey villa with a land area of ​​260m2 and a total construction area of ​​279.1m2 with regular mortgage documentation. The villa is organized: The ground floor (84.9 m2) or the first is a living room and kitchen annex, toilet and corridor. The second floor (97.1 m2) has three bedrooms, a toilet, a corridor and two balconies. The third floor (97.1 m2) has three rooms, a toilet, a corridor and a balcony. For sale: 500,000 Euros
